findings.finding: Cancellation originally checked plan sites rather than every kernel submission.
findings.evidence: owner.cpp before_compute runs before compute/issue; half_step catches CancelledLaunch; after_compute tracks every submitted event as drain tail.

findings.finding: An incomplete speculative prefix must not exchange active temporal state banks.
findings.evidence: candidate.swapped only after an uncancelled half; undo swaps only when candidate.swapped, then restores position/history and invalidates lookup/fp32 caches.

findings.finding: Shared target-verification token publication must not admit draft guesses or stale positions.
findings.evidence: rank1 publishes after checked target completion; matching position+1 release/acquire fence; controller cannot begin next rank1 half until previous rank0 candidate resolved.

findings.finding: Retention may only read target streams and mutate dedicated snapshot storage.
findings.evidence: CopyEngine queues source reads after each layer; host extraction and snapshot zeroing happen after drain; no control flow or arithmetic binding uses snapshots.

findings.finding: Callback lifetimes must not survive their stack frame.
findings.evidence: half observers cleared on normal completion, cancellation and all exceptions before returning; native controller uses no separate cancellation callback now.

findings.finding: Terminal rollback leaves token input and host-derived cache/routing metadata different from the exact pre-speculation image.
findings.evidence: half_step writes token and prepare_token before first cancellation boundary; undo restores history/position/token_history but not token, clears lookup_ids/fp32 metadata, and does not restore selected. Existing committed_terminal gate omits these fields.
findings.scope: Strict terminal all-state equivalence only; preserved nonterminal redo and retention receipts do not prove this case.

runtime_gates: Use cancellation_gate.py and draft_async_gate.py receipts; code review alone is not runtime qualification.
reviewed_followup: Standalone scratch initialization is deterministic zeroing at construction. It closes retention full-allocation parity without changing arithmetic. Actual native/Python cancellation gates total202 and draft/retention gates28 pass current GNU binary.
